# Signet Artists

> Sized to your event and budget, for private events across Colorado. One contract, one named contact for the night, and every rate published before you write to us. Send the date and the venue. We do the rest.

Signet Artists is a live music company for private events in Denver, the Front Range, and the mountain corridor. Rates are published rather than quoted on request; the full card is on the pricing page.

## Pages

- [Blog](https://signetartists.com/blog/): Occasional writing on live music for private events: planning it, pricing it, and the music itself. From Signet Artists in Denver.
- [Check a Date](https://signetartists.com/contact/): Tell us the date, the venue and the guest count. Availability and an exact number back inside 24 to 48 hours, in business hours.
- [Corporate & Galas](https://signetartists.com/corporate/): Office holiday parties, client dinners and member events in Denver and the mountain corridor. Solo to quartet, transitions rehearsed against the run of show, COI and W-9 with the contract, net-30 on approval.
- [Corporate holiday party bands and DJs in Denver, November and December 2026](https://signetartists.com/corporate/holiday-party/): Live music and DJs for Denver corporate holiday parties, November and December 2026. Open dates published, rates published, from $1,500. Book August through October for the best dates.
- [Signet Artists — Live music for private events in Denver, Colorado](https://signetartists.com/): Live music for private events across Colorado. Solo to quartet, one contract, and every rate published before you write to us.
- [The Roster](https://signetartists.com/music/): Seven live acts for private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Singer-songwriter covers, jazz, flamenco, funk, americana and a DJ, solo to quartet. Every act's starting price published.
- [For Planners](https://signetartists.com/planners/): How we work with planners: a named contact before the night, paperwork that arrives with the contract, published pricing you can forward unedited, and unbundling treated as normal.
- [How a booking works](https://signetartists.com/planners/booking/): Every step between the first email and the last invoice for a live band booking: reply times, what arrives with the contract, when the run of show gets locked, and what we need from you at each point.
- [Questions](https://signetartists.com/planners/faq/): The full question list for a live band booking: personnel and subs, deposits and payment, sets and breaks, microphones for speeches, stage and power, decibel caps, song choice.
- [Wedding bands and musicians for Vail, Aspen, Breckenridge and Telluride](https://signetartists.com/planners/mountain/): Live music for weddings and private events at Colorado mountain venues: Vail, Beaver Creek, Aspen, Breckenridge, Telluride, Steamboat and the Broadmoor. Resort rates published, plus the noise limits and curfews each town enforces.
- [Run of show](https://signetartists.com/planners/run-of-show/): Three worked run-of-show templates with the band's rows filled in: a corporate gala, a wedding, and a holiday party. Set times, break placement, volume steps and who cues each moment.
- [What we need from your venue](https://signetartists.com/planners/technical/): Stage footprint, power, channel counts, load-in times and volume at every size we sell, solo to quartet, plus the DJ. Published so a planner can forward them to the venue.
- [Pricing: what a band costs for a private event in Colorado](https://signetartists.com/pricing/): The full published rate card for live music in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Solo from $900, trio from $2,800, quartet from $4,000, DJ from $1,500. Denver and resort columns, no quote required.
- [Repertoire](https://signetartists.com/repertoire/): Six sets that shape a night: arrival, dinner, the turn, dancing, the finish and ceremony, plus the full song book underneath, searchable by moment and energy.

## Acts

- Tejas Singh (Singer-songwriter covers, fronted by Tejas Singh): The only booking here that ladders. A duo at six o'clock and a quartet at ten, same voice, same songs, one contract, so guests hear one band getting bigger rather than two bands swapping over. The quartet is the dance floor booking. Configurations: Duo to quartet. From $2,000 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/artists/tejas-singh/
- Jazz Duo (Jazz standards, Upright bass and guitar): Standards on upright bass and guitar, played at conversation volume. The booking for arrival, cocktails and dinner, when the music has to hold the night without anybody having to raise their voice over it. Configurations: Duo. From $2,000 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/jazz-duo-trio/
- Dirty Flamenco (Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers): The only flamenco act on this roster, and close to the only one in Colorado sold as a private event product rather than a concert booking. Real palos, played by a working group with a standing repertoire. Book it when the night needs one thing guests photograph. Configurations: Trio, larger by request. From $2,800 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/flamenco-trio/
- Thomas Owen Band (Outlaw Americana, fronted by Thomas Owen): Outlaw americana for a patio and the daylight end of an event. Country, roots and the harder edge of the folk-rock catalog, at one piece up to three depending on how much space there is to fill. Sits at conversation volume for three hours without going flat, and has somewhere to go when it does not have to. Outdoor ceremonies, welcome parties and long afternoons. Configurations: Solo to trio. From $900 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/
- Funk Trio (Funk and soul, Guitar, bass, drums, with voice): Funk and soul covers at trio size, for a party where the dance floor is close to the tables. The songs a crowd already knows, played by three people who can fill a floor without needing a stage to do it. Two working trios sit behind this format, which is why it holds a Saturday. Configurations: Trio. From $2,800 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/
- DJ (Open format, Decks, and a PA sized to the venue): Open format, on its own or carrying the late end after a band steps off. Through the same sound system, run by the same team, on the same contract. The most common single booking of the corporate season. Configurations: Solo to duo. From $1,500 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/ensembles/dj/
- Blues Rock (Blues, rock and roots, One voice and a guitar, or two): Blues rock covers, solo or as a duo, at the smallest spend on this roster. Real playing rather than a playlist, at whatever volume the venue will take. Rehearsal dinners, welcome drinks, office parties, and any event where live music is the right idea and a band is the wrong size. Configurations: Solo to duo. From $900 in Denver. https://signetartists.com/music/

## Rate card

Starting prices by configuration. Denver metro, then mountain and resort, which adds travel and lodging.

- Solo: Denver $900–1,200, mountain and resort $1,400–1,900.
- Duo: Denver $2,000–2,800, mountain and resort $2,800–3,800.
- Trio: Denver $2,800–3,800, mountain and resort $3,800–5,200.
- Quartet: Denver $4,000–5,500, mountain and resort $5,500–7,500.
- DJ: Denver $1,500–2,800, mountain and resort $3,000–4,800.
- Five to six piece (by request, not a standard booking): Denver $6,000–8,000, mountain and resort $8,000–11,000.

## Hourly build (Denver metro)

- Duo: $600 call-out + $450/hour. Four hours = $2,400.
- Trio: $1,000 call-out + $600/hour. Four hours = $3,400.
- Quartet: $1,600 call-out + $800/hour. Four hours = $4,800.
- DJ: $800 call-out + $350/hour. Four hours = $2,200.

Price = call-out + (hours x hourly rate). There is no overtime rate. Adding a smaller group to an existing booking bills at the hourly rate only, with no second call-out.
